audit.approval_policy: No candidate is approved or promoted by this audit.

identity_alias_group.description: Same punctuation-insensitive identity key has multiple source display values; only identity linking is safe automatically.

agency_marker_contamination.description: AOTW brands contains an explicit 'by ad agencies:' boundary; values from the marker onward are agency evidence, not brand aliases.

multi_brand_relation_unresolved.description: Multiple advertiser-side values remain and their primary/co-brand/parent/product-line relation is not encoded.

title_brand_mismatch.description: Best Ads or STASH title-prefix brand differs materially from the stored client-derived brand.

cross_source_title_brand_conflict.description: The title-prefix brand appears as a stored brand in another formal source while this record stores a different value.

scalar_composite_brand.description: The scalar brand contains an explicit slash or collaboration marker and should resolve to multiple brand identities.

brand_equals_campaign_title.description: Brand equals campaign title exactly; this may be valid but needs source confirmation rather than automatic acceptance.

company_suffix_brand.description: Stored brand is a legal/company-style entity; it must not be collapsed into a consumer brand by suffix stripping alone.

role_like_brand_value.description: Stored brand begins with a production or personnel role and is likely a source parser error.

missing_or_placeholder_brand.description: Brand is empty or a placeholder.

brand_fields_inconsistent.description: brand, primary_brand, and brands[0] do not represent the same stored source claim.

brand_evidence_unavailable.description: The record lacks a source detail URL, contact sheet, or exact ten-frame visual review required for manual resolution.
